# Business-Model Routing

## 1. Route before writing conclusions

Classify each material segment from evidence. Record primary and secondary archetypes, then close one representative economic unit through revenue, cost, capital, cash, and failure.

| Archetype | Economic object | Metrics to seek |
|---|---|---|
| Manufacturing/hardware | Product, component, shipment, installed base | Volume, price/mix, utilization, yield, unit cost, inventory, warranty, capex, cash conversion. |
| Project/engineering | Award, contract, work package, handover | Backlog, award/win rate, progress, change order, project margin, contract assets/liabilities, retention, guarantees. |
| Distribution/marketplace | Transaction, channel order, partner flow | Take rate, conversion, repeat, inventory ownership, rebates, returns, partner concentration, working capital. |
| Infrastructure/utility | Asset availability or contracted service | Contracted versus merchant, escalation, pass-through, maintenance/growth capex, lease, debt matching, regulation. |
| Software/platform | Subscription, usage, seat, transaction | ARR/usage, bookings, retention, gross margin, CAC/payback, R&D capitalization, deferred revenue, cash conversion. |
| Lender/insurer | Loan/policy, funded risk, claim, reserve | Yield/spread, delinquency, ECL, coverage, loss/combined ratio, solvency, funding, liquidity. |
| Resource/commodity | Reserve, grade, production unit | Production, recovery, realized price, cost curve, sustaining/growth capex, reclamation, cycle sensitivity. |
| Holding/conglomerate | Asset, holding, distribution, realization | Asset bridge, dividend cash, fair value, tax/liquidity/control discount, holding cost, debt, SOTP. |

## 2. Segment route card

For each segment create a table with:

```text
segment | legal/reporting boundary | primary_route | secondary_route |
economic_unit | customer_trigger | product_or_output | sales_path |
revenue_recognition | cost_stack | capital_occupation | cash_timing |
risk_carrier | verification_kpi | failure_path | evidence_status
```

Use the filing's segment note and management reporting to establish the boundary. A brand or product page does not establish a reportable segment. Flag acquisitions, disposals, reclassifications, and intersegment eliminations.

## 3. Economic bridge

For each material line explain:

```text
customer event -> order/contract -> production or service -> delivery/acceptance
-> revenue recognition -> cash collection
```

Then connect the same unit to direct cost, working capital, capex, financing, taxes, and failure. Identify whether the driver is structural, cyclical, transitory, accounting-only, financing-driven, or unresolved.

## 4. Boundaries and negative assertions

Do not infer a customer, market share, product margin, backlog conversion, or utilization from a total segment. Do not call a business recurring when renewal, contract duration, or repeat evidence is absent. State explicitly what the company does not own or control, such as an underlying asset or end-user demand, when that limits the causal claim.
